title: Performance Marketing Manager
description_raw: We are looking for an experienced Performance Marketing Manager (2-4 years) to scale paid acquisition channels across Google Ads and Meta Ads for our D2C brands. Responsibilities include managing ad spends up to 20-30L/month, scaling ROAS, setting up GA4/GTM conversion tracking, conducting A/B experiments on ad copies and landing pages, and presenting weekly CAC/ROAS performance metrics. Must have hands-on experience with Google Search, Performance Max, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, and Looker Studio.
responsibilities: Scale monthly advertising budget across Google and Meta while hitting ROAS targets.
Formulate and execute search query expansion, negative keywords, and PMax asset groups.
Audit and optimize tracking via GA4 events and GTM triggers.
Coordinate with creative teams to produce high-performing video and static ad angles.
